title: Nudge as 'soft pause' bypasses dual-unpause governance
justification: Breaks a documented design invariant. Behodler3's dual-unpause pattern explicitly intends bilateral unpause to prevent owner-only reward denial — the pauser is meant as a check. Setting nudgeSplit=100 to a burn address achieves permanent rewards denial unilaterally with no pauser involvement. Medium per C4 'spec deviation that breaks stated invariant with external requirements (owner action)'. This finding is distinct from pure centralization because it undermines a stated trust-reducing pattern.
preconditions: Owner is malicious or compromised AND wishes to deny rewards without pauser cooperation.
impact: Pauser's role as check on owner reward denial is nullified; documented governance invariant broken.
attack_path_summary: 1) Owner sets nudge=address(0xdead) (or owner-controlled). 2) Owner sets nudgeSplit=100. 3) All future claim revenue routes away from phlimbo; pauser cannot remediate.
